subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear Customer, We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip from New York to London. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: AB123 Departure: 10:00 AM, Date: September 15th, 2023 We hope you have a pleasant journey with us.
